bible.title: The Worth of a Healer
bible.kernel: A fort steward hires the company to fetch a reclusive elven healer who chooses whom to save.

cast.name: Nimphaneth
cast.who: a fort steward who arranges winter supplies and fears supply runs will fail
cast.want: to bring a reclusive elven healer to the fort and bind her service

cast.name: Lythelus Mosswalker
cast.who: an elderwood-born elf who left court and tends the wounded by her own rule
cast.want: to decide whom to save by her own judgment

cast.name: Llavesa
cast.who: a hard-handed logger who runs the winter huts and keeps the camp safe
cast.want: to keep the healer at the huts to tend the camp's injured

bible.situation: Nimphaneth has hired the company to secure an elf healer's service for the fort. The healer lives in the old-growth west of the fort and chooses which wounds deserve saving. The logging camp at the winter huts depends on her care and will resist handing her away.
bible.goal: to secure a reclusive elven healer's service for the hiring steward
arc: Travel to the loggers' winter huts the client named and ask who last saw the healer → yields: Derayna the trapper saying she trailed Lythelus deeper toward the Hollow Stand and pointing to a cedar-wrapped staff left for her

Follow Derayna's trail into the Hollow Stand and use the cedar-wrapped staff as a sign to approach the glade → yields: Lythelus herself, tending three injured children and saying she will leave only if the huts pledge to care for her patients under Llavesa's watch
Return with Lythelus to the loggers' winter huts the client named and force the decision with Llavesa standing guard → yields: Lythelus handed into Nimphaneth's custody as contracted
tensions: Lythelus makes choices about whom to save, so she will not come without a concrete guarantee
The logger camp will not willingly surrender their healer. Llavesa enforces that refusal
The steward's urgency pressures the company to deliver quickly, raising the cost of persuading or defeating the camp
openDirections: a fast-moving cold blight spreads through the Western Forests, forcing communities to choose who receives scarce healing
bible.stakeIfLost: the fort's winter supply convoy will refuse to travel with sick and wounded, leaving the garrison short of provisions
bible.arrival: turned up with the tally-carts · had rehearsed it

shipped.title: Ask the loggers at the winter huts
shipped.situation: A fort steward, Nimphaneth, turned up with the tally-carts and had rehearsed it. She keeps one hand on the door frame while she says the convoy will refuse to travel with sick and wounded. She wants someone at the loggers' winter huts asked who last saw the healer, and the company keeps what it hauls back. Loggers mean to keep the healer at the huts to tend the camp's injured. Nimphaneth had rehearsed every line before she arrived.
shipped.job: Travel to the loggers' winter huts and ask who last saw the healer.
